company.introduction: Games Workshop creates and sells miniature tabletop games and the fictional worlds that support them, most notably Warhammer. Its core business includes models, paints, rulebooks and related hobby products sold through its own stores, independent retailers and online channels. It also earns licensing income when partners use its intellectual property in products such as video games. The model combines design and manufacturing with an enthusiast community that collects, builds, paints and plays with its products. New releases and engagement with established settings help support repeat purchases. Brand ownership and creative development are central, alongside manufacturing capacity, distribution and the appeal of its hobby ecosystem.

overallConfidence.methodology: Overall confidence combines press sentiment (40%), annual-report tone (35%) and emerging themes (25%). Missing signals are excluded and lower-quality evidence pulls the result towards neutral rather than creating a positive score. Where lexical tone is unavailable, annual-report direction is represented once through emerging themes to prevent double counting.
